title: Welcome to the sports centre
instructions: Bir görevli yeni üyelere spor merkezini gezdiriyor. Uzun bir metin; yerleri, kuralları ve saatleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Hello everyone, and welcome to Riverside Sports Centre. My name is Dan, and I'm going to show you around.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: On your left is the reception. You can buy drinks and towels here.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The changing rooms are downstairs. Please don't leave money or phones there. Use the lockers.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The swimming pool is next to the changing rooms. You can't swim without a swimming cap.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The pool is for children only on Saturday mornings, from nine to eleven.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Upstairs, there are two rooms. The big room is for dance and yoga. The small room is the gym.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: In the gym, please always bring a towel and clean the machines after you use them.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: There are tennis courts outside. You need to book them one day before, on the phone or on our website.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The café is near the main door. It closes at eight, but the centre closes at ten.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Have you got any questions? No? Then enjoy your first day!

questions.prompt: What can you buy at the reception?
questions.feedback: Resepsiyonda içecek ve havlu (drinks and towels) satılıyor.
questions.evidence: You can buy drinks and towels here.

questions.prompt: Where should you leave your phone?
When is the pool only for children?
options: every evening from nine to eleven
questions.feedback: Havuz cumartesi sabahları (Saturday mornings) dokuzdan on bire kadar sadece çocuklar için.
questions.evidence: The pool is for children only on Saturday mornings

questions.feedback: Üst katta iki oda var; spor salonu küçük odada (The small room is the gym). Büyük oda dans ve yoga için.
questions.evidence: The small room is the gym.

questions.prompt: What time does the café close?
questions.feedback: Kafe sekizde (at eight) kapanıyor; on, merkezin kapanış saati.
questions.evidence: It closes at eight, but the centre closes at ten.
